ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram shown, which organism consumes the green plant as a primary source of energy?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram shows the Sun at the top, then green plants below it. The green plants are labeled on the right as primary producers. Directly below the green plants is an organism level labeled Herbivores, and on the right this level is labeled primary consumers. Reasoning: Organisms that consume green plants/producers as their main energy source are primary consumers. The diagram identifies the primary consumers as herbivores, so the organism category that consumes the green plant is herbivore.
